segments.name: Loans and Securities
segments.description: Acquires and securitizes newly-originated residential mortgage loans in the non-agency housing market and holds related securities.
segments.evidence: The Company's Residential Investments, Agency RMBS, and Legacy WMC Commercial Investments are included in the Loans and Securities segment.

segments.name: Arc Home
segments.description: Multi-channel licensed mortgage originator and servicer that originates and sells residential mortgage loans and retains servicing rights.
segments.evidence: Arc Home is a multi-channel licensed mortgage originator and servicer led by an external management team.

revenueModel.text: The company earns net interest income on the loans and securities it holds, and Arc Home earns revenue from selling originated mortgage loans and servicing.
revenueModel.evidence: Arc Home generates revenue primarily through originating and selling residential mortgage loans.
